research_question: Do strictly historical, query-time demand/support and candidate-relative demand ranks add stable ranking signal beyond fixed-cutoff popularity, retrieval-source ranks, and the frozen 32-feature domain addition?

availability.snapshot_rule: All counts and last-event timestamps must come from events with ts < snapshot.cutoff_ts; snapshot.cutoff_ts must be <= query_ts.
availability.candidate_normalization: Candidate-relative percentiles and mass shares are computed across the complete candidate set before any target-dependent fitting-negative subsampling.
availability.labels: No future suffix labels are accepted by the feature transform.
availability.semantics: Action-mix statistics are descriptive intensities, not causal conversion rates.

screening.official_metric: pooled weighted Recall@20: 0.1 clicks + 0.3 carts + 0.6 orders
pre_screen: correlation/redundancy diagnostics against frozen baseline and shared features
screening.model_screen: Add/drop family comparison with fixed candidates, fitting negatives, model capacity and seeds.
screening.retain_rule: Retain only features/family with positive fitting-only evidence that survives a second temporal fitting fold/window; no selection/evaluation label-driven formula changes.
screening.stop_rule: Stop on leakage/cutoff mismatch, duplicate information with no incremental evidence, unstable sign across fitting folds, or measured construction cost incompatible with bounded confirmation.

research_sources.title: Public OTTO feature-engineering solution describing item/session/hour statistics and ranks

decision: Implementation only. No feature value, temporal stability, or competition-score improvement is claimed until fitting-only screening and explicit ablation complete.
